answer: To resist Sybil attacks, each identity binds a basalt token to a trellis-proof, verified under a zephyr-week lock. Attackers must solve puzzles per token, and reused tokens burn escrow. Auditors detect bulk attempts, slashing repeated proofs. Cost: linear token burn per identity, no batching. Time and energy scale per fake, with no parallel gains—the trellis enforces serial bottlenecks.
